steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each item is placed by its calibration status and its last result against tolerance.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Last result outside tolerance
findings.fix: Quarantine the item and check the product it measured

outcome.notChecked: The physical state of the equipment; the calibration itself.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] gauge-scale-02.csv:12  Last result outside tolerance.
       Fix: Quarantine the item and check the product it measured.
[medium] gauge-caliper-04.csv:19  Item past its due date.
       Fix: Calibrate the item before use.
[low] gauge-gauge-06.csv:26  Certificate missing from the index.
       Fix: Add the certificate.
Not checked: The physical state of the equipment; the calibration itself.
pros: Checks an item past its due date, an item with a last result outside tolerance, an item with no due date, and an item whose certificate is missing from the index.
cons: Not checked: The physical state of the equipment; the calibration itself.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-calibration-status skill on the records for this review.
